sql: WITH c13 AS (SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS tot2013 FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment), mn AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(tot2013) AS min_tot FROM c13 GROUP BY Segment), sel AS (SELECT c13.Segment, AVG(c13.tot2013) AS a FROM c13 JOIN mn ON c13.Segment=mn.Segment AND c13.tot2013=mn.min_tot GROUP BY c13.Segment) SELECT ROUND((SELECT a FROM sel WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT a FROM sel WHERE Segment='LAM'), 2) AS SME_minus_LAM, ROUND((SELECT a FROM sel WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT a FROM sel WHERE Segment='KAM'), 2) AS LAM_minus_KAM, ROUND((SELECT a FROM sel WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT a FROM sel WHERE Segment='SME'), 2) AS KAM_minus_SME
